speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; can you tell me how many days old you are and exactly when these symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus.

Given the patient is six hours old with bilious vomiting and a family history of pyloric stenosis, the immediate life-threatening concern is intestinal malrotation with volvulus, which requires emergent surgical evaluation. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound; REQUEST IMAGES: Upper GI Contrast Series.
